outcome: Fetal heart rate variability (HRV) time domain metrics (SDNN, RMSSD)
cohort: The study included 96 women aged >= 16 years with either gestational diabetes mellitus (GDM) or an uncomplicated pregnancy (control), who were > 20 weeks gestational age.
finding: Pregnancies complicated by GDM were associated with alterations in fetal heart rate variability (higher SDNN in sleep state 1F) and FHR, and these measures correlated with maternal BMI and HbA1c.
cross-section timing: Measurements were taken from women > 20 weeks gestational age during an overnight recording.
